title: Know the size you need
text: Know the size you need. I bought to store my comforters better.. you can fit probably 3 comforters to 1 bag. Which then you cant store again properly. In order to get a good suction use vacuum and have bag upright.  The piece they give to suction air did not work. Would proabably buy again but in much smaller size.
